Sign in

Thermocouple cure analysis is restricted to registered users. Operators see the cure test report; R&D admins also see the engineering analysis and the configuration.

First launch — create the accounts

This engine file has no accounts yet. Create the R&D administrator, and optionally a first operator. Passwords are stored only as salted hashes; at least 8 characters with letters and digits. After creating them you will download the configured engine file — use that file from then on.
R&D administrator
First operator optional — more can be added later

R&D configuration

Read-only in the demo. This is where R&D manages accounts, tyre profiles, spec limits and compound DNA, then publishes one configured engine file for the plant. Browse the tabs to see what is configurable; nothing here can be changed or exported.

In the licensed engine, R&D publishes one self-contained file with the accounts, tyre profiles, spec limits and compound DNA built in. Operators only ever get that file, and it runs offline on the plant PC.

Compound TC90 — batch MDR (this tyre)

The compounds present in this tyre, filtered by family. Enter each compound's batch lab TC90 (minutes, at its lab temperature) for the tested tyre — these feed %CEF only; CEQ is unaffected. Defaults are the characterised reference t90; overwrite with your batch values.

Positions and HIOKI WAVE file

First choose the positions recorded in this test — all 22 by default. Click a number on the section, or use the zone buttons. Channels are mapped by logger position, following the procedure (file comment-names are ignored). Then load the raw export (.TXT) from the HIOKI LR8400.
